jess: Heads-up — onboarding 'rose-30b-rotary' today. Need quick sanity checks: weights location, tokenizer quirks, RoPE scaling, GQA/MQA flags, sliding-window/KV prefetch behavior. Anyone available? (cc @alex @ryan @marta)

alex: I can take weights + runtime config. Where are the weights?

jess: s3://rw-models/rose/30b/rotary/2026-03-15/weights.tar.gz — unpacked layout: model-00001-of-00008.bin + config.json + tokenizer.model

alex: thx. quick grep of config shows 'rope_scaling': {'type':'linear', 'factor':1.2} — can you paste full config? our runtime expects rope_scaling to be in config['attn_bias'] or as 'rope_scaling' float. Also need head/group check for MQA.

jess: ```json
{
  "hidden_size": 5120,
  "num_attention_heads": 40,
  "rope_scaling": {"type":"linear","factor":1.2},
  "head_dim": 128,
  "qk_group_size": 8,
  "mqa": true
}
```

alex: runtime currently supports 'rope_scaling' as either float or {'type':'dynamic','alpha':...}. Our parser will throw if it sees object with 'type':'linear'. Try converting to float 1.2 for the onboarding alias.

ryan: Tokenizer issue: tokenizer.model is sentencepiece v1 but vocab size 50265; runtime tokenizer loader expects 50257 or needs special unk token mapping. When we tried in local load, we saw <unk> token id 0 vs runtime expecting 3. Patch: add tokenizer.json alias mapping or set unk_token id in converter.

jess: noted — I can run convert_tokenizer.py --spm tokenizer.model --target-json token.json --unk-id 3. Also noticed config has qk_group_size 8, but our GQA expects group_qkv=5 for 40 heads? what's correct calculation?

marta: GQA (grouped q/k/v) group size should divide num_heads. With 40 heads and head_dim 128, group_qkv 8 works (40/8=5 groups). But MQA true + qk_group_size present is fine. Need to ensure runtime flag 'use_mqa': true and 'gqa_groups':8.

alex: sliding window: runtime default kv-cache window 2048; model attn context 4096, so we must enable streaming sliding-window with chunking. Suggest setting 'max_seq_len':4096 and 'kv_prefetch': true and 'kv_chunk_size':1024. Also add canary test: run perf probe with prompt length 1000 then extend to 3500 and compare latencies.

alex: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/engines/rose-30b/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{\n  "prompt":"The quick brown fox ... (1000 tokens)",\n  "max_tokens":64,\n  "runtime_opts":{"rope_scaling":1.2,"gqa_groups":8,"kv_chunk_size":1024}\n}'
```

deploy-bot: artifact-scan result: weights checksum mismatch on model-00003-of-00008 (expected abc123 got def456) — blocking upload until rechecksum.

jess: ack, re-uploading chunk 3 now. tagging in PR for tokenizer conversion and config mapping: https://github.com/redwood/serve/pull/4822

ryan: small note — rotation implementation in our runtime uses pairwise RoPE with scale param 'rope_scale' not 'rope_scaling'. Converter should rename key.

marta: also check attention impl: if model uses rotary sin/cos with 32-bit precompute, runtime may quantize to int8 and lose precision for long-span dependencies. Add eval prompt set for math/long-range coherence.

alex: I'll do quick CR for runtime config mapping and add fallback path to treat object -> float by using factor value. pinging @eng-oncall if anything fails.

jess: thanks team — I'll reupload weights, run tokenizer conversion, and kick the canary probes. will post results here. :thumbsup:
